title: This just made me sad all around, I wouldn't pay 10 cents for this garbage
text:
This just made me sad all around, I wouldn't pay 10 cents for this garbage. Right out of the box I notice that this has TERRIBLE craftsmanship. It's not good quality at all, the back part of it- the wood is separating where it wasn't glued together well at the factory. You could put some glue in there and kinda fix it but it'll never look great. Just little things all over it show me that it was poorly made. As if that wasn't enough- they added extra and wrong notes into the song and the song is nearly unrecognizable. It's a song me and my friend love and when I played it for him, he couldn't tell me what song it was.

Absolutely skip this one, terrible quality all around!
